edges.guidance: Create the operator that will occupy the first computed position.
edges.pitfalls: Creating operators before positions are computed forces a second move pass.

edges.guidance: Computed positions also drive the layout annotation shown to the user.
The new connections feed the annotation describing the network.
Set the operator's position to its computed target.
edges.pitfalls: Leaving a new operator at its default position hides layout intent.

edges.guidance: Creation triggers connecting the operator into the existing network.
edges.pitfalls: Connecting before position is set makes the resulting wires hard to read.

edges.guidance: Compute target positions for every operator in the group.
edges.pitfalls: Ignoring existing spacing conventions produces cluttered layouts.

edges.guidance: Group membership narrows which operators need a dock-state query.
edges.pitfalls: Stale membership data yields a query against the wrong operators.

edges.guidance: With no docked operator to reposition, proceed straight to verification.
edges.pitfalls: Verifying too early misses a dock relationship formed later in the pass.

edges.guidance: Dock state is recorded in the annotation regardless of the query result.
edges.pitfalls: Omitting a negative dock result makes the annotation look incomplete.

edges.guidance: Identify the operator group that needs repositioning.
edges.pitfalls: Do not assume a single group; a selection may span several.

edges.guidance: Both the docked and moved operators are now placed; verify the pair.
edges.pitfalls: Verifying only the moved operator misses drift in its docked partner.

edges.guidance: The new position is the input for repositioning any docked operator.
edges.pitfalls: Using the pre-move position here reintroduces the overlap being fixed.

edges.guidance: Query whether the moved operator is docked to another.
edges.pitfalls: Skipping the dock query can silently detach a docked pair.

edges.guidance: Read the existing network layout before making changes.
With the annotation current, verify the layout it describes.
edges.pitfalls: An unverified layout can drift out of sync with its own annotation.

edges.condition: Annotation updated and layout already verified.
edges.pitfalls: Ending without a verification step leaves silent misplacements uncaught.

edges.condition: Verification finds a position still out of tolerance.
edges.guidance: Return to Set_Position and correct the flagged operator.
edges.pitfalls: Repeating verification without changing tolerance can loop indefinitely; cap retries.
